title: Backup Verification
description: Validate that backups are complete, restorable, and stored off-site.

steps.title: Confirm Backup Schedule
steps.instructions: Verify daily database and weekly full-file backups are scheduled. Align frequency with client SLA and change velocity.

steps.title: Verify Off-Site Storage
steps.instructions: Confirm backups copy to S3, Google Drive, or another region separate from the web server. Check encryption at rest.

steps.title: Test Database Restore
steps.instructions: Restore the latest database backup to staging. Confirm posts, options, and users match production counts.

steps.title: Test Media / Uploads Restore
steps.instructions: Restore uploads or a sample of media files. Open pages that rely on large images or PDF downloads.

steps.title: Document RTO & RPO
steps.instructions: Record recovery time objective and recovery point objective for the client. Note who approves emergency restores.

steps.title: Exclude Cache & Log Bloat
steps.instructions: Ensure backup jobs skip cache folders and oversized log files to keep backup size manageable and restores fast.
